reg [1:0] state;
	parameter [1:0]
		IDLE = 2'b00,
		LEFT = 2'b01,
		RIGHT = 2'b10;

	always @(posedge clk or posedge areset) begin
		if (areset) begin
			state <= IDLE;
		end else begin
			case (state)
				IDLE: begin
					if (bump_left) begin
						state <= LEFT;
					end else if (bump_right) begin
						state <= RIGHT;
					end
				end
				LEFT: begin
					if (bump_left) begin
						state <= LEFT;
					end else begin
						state <= IDLE;
					end
				end
				RIGHT: begin
					if (bump_right) begin
						state <= RIGHT;
					end else begin
						state <= IDLE;
					end
				end
			endcase
		end
	end

	assign walk_left = (state == LEFT);
	assign walk_right = (state == RIGHT);

endmodule
